description.text: A rain-streaked bus window fills a narrow vertical frame at night, the glass close enough to show beads of water, thin runnels and the soft grain of condensation. Beyond the pane, the city dissolves into blurred shopfronts, amber streetlights and red-white headlights that slide past in smooth out-of-focus streaks. Every droplet on the glass trembles with the bus's movement; some merge and drag sideways, leaving glossy tracks that catch the passing light. Faint interior reflections ghost across the surface, hinting at the dark cabin behind the viewer, while the night outside keeps changing in slow ribbons of color. The window remains the still center of the image as the lights beyond drift continuously, and the wet surface shifts between clear patches and dense beaded texture. Rain gathers along the lower edge and clings in trembling clusters before slipping away. Cool blue shadows, warm sodium highlights and the black of the unlit street create a quiet, enclosed mood, with all attention held on the moving water and the city reduced to soft shapes.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

One heavy rivulet dominates the close view, carving a wavering vertical path down the glass as it sweeps up smaller beads and sends them tumbling into its course. The droplet track glistens with reflected light, thickening and thinning as it descends, while surrounding beads quiver and occasionally break free. Behind the pane, a passing streetlamp flares into a long amber smear that stretches across the wet surface, slides sideways and exits the frame, leaving the glass darker and the rivulet briefly brightened. Other blurred lights follow as distant smears of pale white and red, never resolving into objects. The rain-slick pane shows every ripple and refraction, with the descending line of water drawing the eye through a field of tiny trembling droplets. The surface remains wet and restless, and the last light behind it fades into a deep blue-black night.
The camera zooms in with small amplitude at slow speed.
